description:
On the surface, life flows through a series of mundane daily routines and ordinary social connections. Yet, beneath this veneer of normalcy lies a hidden world of unspoken desires and strictly forbidden emotions. What begins as a mere accident ignites an uncontrollable spark that quickly rages out of hand. The magnetic attraction between them, once a subtle pull, now spirals into a deeper, more intoxicating pursuit of pure pleasure. 

A single, misguided choice has birthed a taboo relationship that defies all social boundaries. As the stakes rise, the characters find themselves sinking further into a treacherous mire of ecstasy from which there is no escape. The path back to their former lives has been utterly severed, leaving them to drown in the very sensations they once feared. This is a story of the thin line between restraint and the point of no return.

(Source: Lezhin US)
